command: cd /code && Rscript -e 'load("/data/ratingData5"); ratingData5$USval <- ifelse(substr(as.character(ratingData5$correspondingUS), 1, 1) == "p", "positive", "negative"); ratingData5$USval <- as.factor(ratingData5$USval); ratingData5Aggr <- aggregate(likingRating ~ ParticipantNumber * USval * correspondingTime, ratingData5, mean); library(tidyr); ratingData5AggrW <- spread(ratingData5Aggr, key = "USval", value = "likingRating"); ratingData5AggrW$EC <- ratingData5AggrW$positive - ratingData5AggrW$negative; ratingData5AggrW$pTime <- ifelse(as.character(ratingData5AggrW$correspondingTime) == "153", "30 ms", "1000 ms"); print(aggregate(EC ~ pTime, ratingData5AggrW, mean)); print(tapply(ratingData5AggrW$EC, ratingData5AggrW$pTime, mean));'
